articles.title: Bitfinex traders double down on bitcoin during five-day slide as longs hit 2.5-year high
articles.snippet: Margin longs on Bitfinex have climbed to a two-and-a-half year high as bitcoin struggles below key technical resistance near $78,000.

articles.title: WLFI-linked AI Financial flags ‘going concern’ as losses mount
articles.snippet: AI Financial Corp. posted a net loss of $271.5 million in the first quarter of 2026 as it flagged significant doubt about its ability to continue operating for the next 12 months.

articles.title: Solana futures funding rate turns negative: Is $78 SOL next?
articles.snippet: Solana futures funding turned negative as demand for SOL and its associated decentralized exchanges fell. Will traders buy the dip or is $78 next?

articles.title: Data shows Bitcoin dip buyers waiting for lower prices: Is $70K BTC’s next stop?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin futures and orderbook data show dip buyers waiting for a BTC price drop below $70,000.

articles.title: Crypto Wealth Firm Nexo Sponsors $3 Million Golf Tournament at Trump International Scotland
articles.snippet: Trump International Golf Links will again host the DP World Tour's Nexo Championship, now with a $3 million prize pool.
